company.shortDescription: Datadog is an observability and security platform that offers infrastructure, applications, software development, and monitoring services.
company.description: Datadog is an observability and security platform that offers infrastructure, applications, software development, and monitoring services. It brings together data from servers, containers, databases, and third-party services to make your stack entirely observable. These capabilities help DevOps teams avoid downtime, resolve performance issues, and ensure customers are getting the best user experience.

aiResearchSummary.text: Datadog is researching systems such as Time-Series Optimized Transformer for Observability to process multivariate time series, Detecting Faulty Deployments Using Weak Supervision to quickly flag bad software releases, and Vulnerability Detection And Smart Remediation Using Runtime Data to build enriched runtime dependency trees. It also develops Duplication Avoidance For Mutable Event Based Metrics and a Protocol for correlating user space data with kernel space data, advancing observability, deployment quality, security, metrics, and low level monitoring.
